texts.en:
Digital industry is booming. From the thrill of simulating a first person adventure to relaxing on a digital resort, virtual entertainment has never been more engaging - or as addictive. While this burgeoning industry represents a key economic driver, production in the physical world has begun to suffer as people spend more and more time in their digital utopias. Some are in danger of losing touch with "real" life completely, but could still contribute to society by participating in the digital economy.

Should we ban addictive virtual worlds, promote them as a new form of lucrative entertainment or find a middle ground through regulation?

# 无限可能性矩阵 / Infinite Possibility Matrix

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “合成冲击”事件链后段：隐藏事件 synth.1000 从 on_synthshock_chain_opportunity_events_list（1010、1020、1030，权重各5）抽取一个。
  Late part of the "Synth Shock" chain: hidden synth.1000 draws one of 1010, 1020, 1030 (weight 5 each) from on_synthshock_chain_opportunity_events_list.
- 无额外触发条件。
  No extra trigger.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「无限可能性矩阵」：synth_virtual_world_outlaw；享乐类政体有 _promote（含团结）；_regulate。
  "Infinite Possibility Matrix": synth_virtual_world_outlaw; hedonist civics get _promote (with unity); _regulate.
- 事件结束后180+随机90天由隐藏事件 synth.1500 选出最终事件 synth.1505–1525 之一（共享结局，视为枢纽）。
  After 180 days (+ random 90) hidden synth.1500 picks one of the final events synth.1505-1525 (a shared ending, treated as a hub).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口（无后续或只通向共享结局）；选项互斥，只能选一个。
  A single window (no follow-up, or only into the shared ending); options are exclusive, only one is chosen.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 选项集合随帝国的伦理、权威、政体特质而变，见条件。
  The available options vary with ethics, authority and civics, see the conditions.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/machine_age_situation_events_2.txt:2089-2186`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`
- 已核对：来源池与权重、触发条件、选项分支与目标事件。
  Checked: source pool and weights, trigger conditions, option branches and target events.
- 未逐行核对选项的数值收益，只记录其性质（修正名、资源、标志）。
  Option numbers were not checked line by line; only their nature (modifier names, resources, flags) is recorded.
